findings.highlight: I'm just helping the school by repairing old equipment
findings.evidenceJa: 学校の備品を直すのは生徒として当たり前だろ
findings.governingReading: He rejects the student-council framing because students naturally ought to repair equipment they use.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s claim that maintaining shared equipment is a student’s ordinary duty is reduced to merely helping the school.

findings.highlight: how much you piss me off
findings.evidenceJa: そういういい子ぶりが癇に障る
findings.governingReading: He says Shirou’s affected good-child behavior gets on his nerves.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s charge that Shirou is performing the role of a good boy disappears.

findings.highlight: the range hasn't been cleaned recently
findings.evidenceJa: 安土の掃除もできてない
findings.governingReading: Shinji specifically lists the azuchi among the neglected facilities.
findings.explanation: The uncleaned azuchi, the earthen target bank in a kyūdō range, becomes the range generally.

findings.highlight: they must be the members Shinji recruited recently
findings.evidenceJa: 部員たちだろうか
findings.governingReading: Because he recognizes none of them, he wonders whether they are the members Shinji has lately recruited.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s question whether the unfamiliar girls are Shinji’s recent recruits becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: I considered trying to shoot a bit
findings.evidenceJa: 弓を手に取ったが
findings.governingReading: He takes a bow in hand, briefly considers using it, then stops because stringing another person’s bow would be rude.
findings.explanation: Shirou physically picking up the bow before deciding not to string it disappears.

findings.highlight: there's no sign of life in the empty school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校には熱気というものがない
findings.governingReading: After curfew the empty school lacks 熱気, its heat, energy, or human warmth.
findings.explanation: The school’s lost human warmth becomes “no sign of life.”

findings.highlight: It sounds like a fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 何者かが刃物で斬り合っている
findings.governingReading: From the metal sounds he imagines unidentified people slashing at one another with edged weapons.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference that people are cutting at one another with blades becomes only “a fight.”

findings.highlight: clad in armor so ancient
findings.evidenceJa: 物々しい武装をした両者
findings.governingReading: The two men are equipped with forbidding weapons and gear so anachronistic that they surpass parody.
findings.explanation: Ominously heavy, anachronistic armament becomes ancient armor.

findings.highlight: killed by a bladed weapon
findings.evidenceJa: 刀のような凶器で惨殺された
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls that the murdered family was said to have been slaughtered with something like a Japanese sword.
findings.explanation: The reported katana-like murder weapon becomes a generic bladed weapon.

findings.highlight: another, stronger sense of malice
findings.evidenceJa: いっそう強い殺気
findings.governingReading: When the combatants pause, Shirou senses even stronger murderous intent.
findings.explanation: An intensified killing presence becomes generalized malice.

findings.highlight: I still imagine getting stabbed in the back with that spear.
findings.evidenceJa: 真後ろからあの槍を突きつけられているような気がして
findings.governingReading: From over forty meters away, Shirou physically feels as if the spear is being thrust or leveled at him from directly behind.
findings.explanation: Feeling as though a spear is held at his back becomes imagining being stabbed.

findings.highlight: The man in red is dead meat.
findings.evidenceJa: あの赤いヤツは殺される
findings.governingReading: He repeats that the red figure will be killed by the coming blow.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stark certainty that the red man will be killed becomes the slangy “dead meat.”

findings.highlight: My chest burns from all the running.
findings.evidenceJa: 限界以上に走りづめだった心臓が軋む
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s overworked heart creaks or strains after the sprint.
findings.explanation: A heart straining after running beyond its limit becomes a burning chest.

findings.highlight: I definitely wasn't meant to see that.
findings.evidenceJa: 見てはいけないモノだった
findings.governingReading: He concludes only that the spectacle was something forbidden or dangerous to witness.
findings.explanation: Something Shirou should not have seen becomes something he was not meant to see.

findings.highlight: No training I ever did prepared me for this.
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで鍛えてきた成果なんて一片も通じなかった
findings.governingReading: None of the results of his years of training avails him even slightly against the thrust.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s accumulated training proving completely useless becomes training that did not prepare him.

findings.highlight: That spear must have been special.
findings.evidenceJa: 槍は特別製だったのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: As his blood stagnates, Shirou speculates that the man’s spear may have been specially made.
findings.explanation: The spear possibly being special becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: Afterwards, I hear footsteps fading down the hallway.
findings.evidenceJa: その後に、廊下を駆けてくる足音が
findings.governingReading: After Lancer speaks, Shirou hears someone running down the corridor toward the scene.
findings.explanation: Approaching footsteps after Lancer’s speech become footsteps fading away.

findings.highlight: the person touches me without hesitation
findings.evidenceJa: 血に濡れた俺に触れてきた
findings.governingReading: After gritting her teeth in frustration, the person touches the blood-covered Shirou without hesitation.
findings.explanation: The rescuer’s immediate contact with Shirou’s blood-soaked body loses the blood.

findings.highlight: Forging and replacing an entire heart
findings.evidenceJa: 破損した臓器を偽造して代用、その間に心臓一つまるまる修復
findings.governingReading: The rescuer plans to forge a substitute for the damaged organ, use it temporarily, and meanwhile repair one whole heart.
findings.explanation: The two-stage repair becomes forging and replacing an entire heart.

findings.highlight: I should be a shoo-in for the Clock Tower.
findings.evidenceJa: 時計塔に一発合格ってレベルじゃない
findings.governingReading: She judges success to exceed even the level of instant admission to the Clock Tower.
findings.explanation: A feat far beyond automatic Clock Tower admission becomes merely enough to be a shoo-in.

findings.highlight: my fading consciousness finally flickers to nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: 薄れていくだけの意識がピタリと止まった
findings.governingReading: At the start of treatment, the consciousness that had only continued fading comes to a complete halt in that fading; sensation then begins returning.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s fading consciousness stopping its decline becomes his consciousness going out.

findings.highlight: my corpse jolts
findings.evidenceJa: 死んでいた体を驚かせるぐらい熱かった
findings.governingReading: Shirou supposes the heat was enough to surprise his dead body, allowing frozen blood to flow again.
findings.explanation: Heat startling a body that had been dead becomes a corpse literally jolting.
